# Cosonova

> Cosonova is a creative social platform: a single space to post ideas, join
> communities, share short-form video signals, publish stories, and buy or
> sell creative work.

## Core areas

- [Home](https://cosonova.com/): Personalized feed of posts from people and communities you follow.
- [Discover](https://cosonova.com/discover): Trending posts, topics, communities, creators, and signals.
- [Bazaar](https://cosonova.com/bazaar): Post ideas and back other people's ideas.
- [Communities](https://cosonova.com/communities): Public and private groups organized around shared interests.
- [Shop](https://cosonova.com/shop): Marketplace for digital and physical creative goods made by Cosonova creators.
- [Reels / Signals](https://cosonova.com/reels): Short-form video feed.
- [Forge](https://cosonova.com/forge): Collaborative story-building tool.
- [Museum](https://cosonova.com/museum): Exhibition of abandoned or failed ideas and challenges from the Bazaar.
- [Characters](https://cosonova.com/characters): Gallery of AI-generated character cards.
- [Simulator](https://cosonova.com/simulator): Tool for exploring creative-persona traits.
- [Garden](https://cosonova.com/garden): Visualizes Bazaar ideas' growth as they gain backers and funding.
- [About](https://cosonova.com/about): What Cosonova is and what you can do here.
- [FAQ](https://cosonova.com/faq): Answers to common questions about coins, the Bazaar, the Shop, and subscriptions.

## Notes for automated agents and crawlers

- Most content requires an account to view or interact with; the pages
  listed above are the ones accessible without signing in.
- Authenticated areas (settings, chat, wallet, notifications, admin) are not
  intended for indexing — see /robots.txt.
